notes.title: Reima Project joins "The Days of Ramadan" Fest on Steam! 🌙✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961561/e811862ab2d49a6dace4a8984bd8f7ee464da58c.jpg[/img]

[h2]We're excited to announce that Reima Project will be part of [b]"The Days of Ramadan"[/b] Fest hosted by [b]SEAgamethetic[/b] on Steam![/h2]

From February 28 - March 31, you can check out our games there:
[list]
[*] 🦆 Quacker Bros: First Heist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103830
[*] 🍖 Dinner Defenders (wishlist or play the early demo)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866980/Dinner_Defenders/
[*] ⚔️ Saber Survivors
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116810
[*] 🌰 It's Raining Acorn
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3440980/Its_Raining_Acorn/
[/list]

[h3]Don't miss the chance to play, wishlist, and enjoy these games during the festival! Happy gaming and Happy Ramadan! 🌙✨[/h3]

notes.title: Deflect Boy is releasing very soon!
notes.content:
Hi folks, we've got some news!
Our next game is releasing very soon!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44943224/dfbd98561d6f8396716b576688583449fe5fe8b5.png[/img]

If you haven't already, don't forget to wishlist it so that you will be the first to play it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811910

[h1]So what is Deflect Boy?[/h1]

It's a top-down arena shooter with a twist! In normal shooter you will have guns, but here you cannot shoot by your own! Instead, you will control a shield that deflect the bullets.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44943224/077384945068fb89d93e865cad42314af754541a.gif[/img]

You will also have the ability to upgrade and tweak your shield abilities that makes defeating enemies easier.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44943224/1db4b62ecf47616be27199ab5d372d638d2bb0f6.gif[/img]

Give it a try and send us your feedback and reviews.
See you on the release day!

-Bedivere (Reima Project)
